note: Republic Bank's Grenada price list of rates and fees (October 2026, its card fees effective from 2 December 2024), read in full, with its Mastercard Standard and Visa Classic pages. The three Mastercards (Standard, Gold, AAdvantage), in Eastern Caribbean dollars: the annual membership fee from the price list, plus VAT, written as the 15% VAT the same list adds to its other charges; 16% a year on purchases (the card page, rates in effect as of 1 February 2022; the bank says the rate is set on approval and could be 16%); a minimum payment of 2.77% of the balance, at least $54; a cash advance fee of 3.2%, at least $15; a late payment fee of 3% of the minimum payment due, at least $28.75; an over limit fee of 5% of the excess, at least $40.25 (the price list's figures, which replace the card page's older flat late and over limit charges); the card page's $30 returned cheque charge; and up to 50 days free of interest on purchases once the balance has been paid in full for two consecutive months (written as 50; the two-month condition isn't modelled). The Visa Classic and Visa Gold, in US dollars (annual fees from 15 November 2025): 1.33% a month, which the bank gives as 16% a year and is written so; a cash advance fee of 2.3%; a late fee of 3% of the minimum payment, at least $8; an over limit fee of 5% of the excess, at least $12; the same 50 days. The Visa Business card isn't written; nor are additional, replacement card and statement charges. Neither source states a foreign transaction fee or a penalty rate, and the Visa cards' minimum payment isn't published.
